The '''Necropolis''' is an area on the south-eastern coast of the [[Kharidian Desert]]. It is the location of the [[Jaltevas Pyramid]], otherwise known as the [[Tombs of Amascut]], which is in actuality the ancient tomb of [[Osmumten]], the last Chosen of [[Tumeken]]. Entering the Necropolis requires partial completion of [[Beneath Cursed Sands]].  

== Transportation ==

* {{Plink|Fairy ring|pic=Fairy ring (Construction) icon}} {{Fairycode|akp}} —  an island just off the coast, by the mine. Requires 62 [[Agility]] to cross.
* {{Plink|Pharaoh's sceptre}} — [[Jaltevas Pyramid|Jaltevas]], the [[Tombs of Amascut]] lobby. To unlock this teleport, players must first commune with the [[Obelisk (Necropolis)|obelisk]] just north of the mine while having a [[pharaoh's sceptre]] in the inventory.
* {{Plink|Nardah teleport}} — [[Nardah]] town centre, a long run north of the area.
* {{Plink|Desert amulet 2|txt=Desert amulets}} — [[Elidinis Statuette|Temple of Elidinis]] in Nardah. Amulets 2 and 3 offer one teleport daily; amulet 4 offers unlimited teleports.

== History ==
The Necropolis was, for a long time, buried under the sand, until a storm came in from the south and unearthed it. Even so, not many visit it due to superstitions associated with it, such as the sand being marked by death, though it is also believed by some that the colour of the sand is simply due to the amount of salt in it.{{CiteNPC|npc=Priest (Sophanem)|quote=There's a lot of superstition about the place. People say that even the sand is marked by death. (...) The sand is probably that colour due to the amount of salt in it.}}

After its unearthing, the spy [[Maisa]] contacts and adventurer about suspicious activity in the ruins. It [[Beneath Cursed Sands|soon becomes revealed]] that missing [[Citizen (Menaphos)|Menaphites]] had been hypnotized by the Devourer, and were being forced to excavate the [[Jaltevas Pyramid]] within the necropolis! Maisa then [[Into the Tombs|tasked the adventurer with venturing into the tombs]] to defeat [[Amascut|the Devourer]]. The adventurer was able to contact [[Osmumten]], but learned that the Devourer's forces would soon return to the pyramid.

== Features ==

* The [[Necropolis mine]], containing several [[granite rocks]] and [[sandstone rocks]], as well as several [[Kharidian cactus|Kharidian cacti]].

* The Necropolis [[Hunter#Hunter areas|Hunter area]], with five [[young tree]]s that can be used to catch [[Orange salamander (Hunter)|orange salamanders]]
* The Tombs of Amascut raid takes place deep inside the Jaltevas Pyramid.
